name: Christine Ko
bio:
Christine Ko (born 1988) is an American actress known for her roles as Emma on the CBS sitcom The Great Indoors, Mandi on Upload and Emma on Dave. Before success in America, she had a brief career in Taiwan in the early 2010s.
